headline: Oilers’ Ryan Nugent-Hopkins to make season debut against Hurricanes
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Ryan Nugent-Hopkins will make his season debut against the Hurricanes after missing each of the Oilers' games with a lower-body injury.

Edmonton returns him at 7-1-1, but the underlying numbers say the Oilers have been riding results more than play. EDM holds 53.5% of the expected goals (a measure of shot quality) so far this season, a solid but unspectacular figure, and it is exactly even at 5-on-5 with 50%. Meanwhile EDM has scored 12.9 more goals than its chances would predict, which is the kind of finishing that rarely holds. That makes the missing forward matter more, since the team's record looks sturdier than its process. Carolina, his opponent, sits at 8-1... rather 8-2-1 with 61.5% of the expected goals and 58% at 5-on-5, though it has scored 2.8 fewer goals than expected, so its record undersells it. The matchup pits a team beating its numbers against one trailing them.
